final: WITH mix_counts AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS behaviour_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON a.translink = t.transreg GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), shares AS (SELECT ordertypedist, behaviour_count, behaviour_count * 1.0 / SUM(behaviour_count) OVER () AS share FROM mix_counts), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT s.ordertypedist, s.behaviour_count, s.share, s.share - b.average_share AS above_baseline FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE s.share > b.average_share
